paragraphs: This is my family page, and my name is Mia. I am nine years old. I live next to Lily's house. There are three people and one cat in my family. My mom is a doctor at the town hospital. She has long black hair and a green bike. She rides to work on her bike every morning. Her work is exciting. She helps sick people every day. Mom is very kind, and she is always busy.

My dad has a small shop. He fixes bikes there, and he has red helmets. Dad has short black hair and a short beard. He has an old guitar. He plays it badly. When Dad plays, Snow runs out of the room. "Please play in the garden, Dad!" says Mom. Mom and I both laugh, and Dad laughs too.

I have two books about animals and a pink bag. I love animals. Our cat is called Snow. She is a small white kitten. She eats a lot, so she is a little fat. She has a red ball and a warm bed. Snow likes to go out into the garden. She must be in the house at night. I must close the door before bed. Every day I give her food and water. We are a small family, but we are very happy. Who is in your family? What do you have at home?
